notes.title: HPAWS Mobile is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9011622/445a9b80a2e474e53291e2d16cb981fb1a60d9e7.jpg[/img]

[h1]HPAWS Mobile is now LIVE on both the App Store and Google Play Store![/h1]

Link to Google Play Store:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.daylightstudios.hpawsmob

Link to App Store:

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/holy-potatoes-a-weapon-shop/id1048011718?mt=8

Now two issues arise with the iOS version of HPAWS. First of all, since the UI differs from the iPhone and iPad version, we had to make two separate apps. We tried to bundle them together so that you could buy both for the price of one (as it rightfully should be) but since none of the versions are universal, Apple did not allow us to bundle them together.

Having said that, we are actively working on creating a universal app of the iPhone version so that it is playable on both iPhones and iPads, but the iPad version will be letterboxed as seen below:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9011622/43c727fbf50fb0e825ce8afdc6f11bbbd71c89cf.jpg[/img]

The second issue that arises is that we have not implemented an iCloud save yet, but we are working hard on getting that implemented. What we are trying to do is create a universal iCloud saving feature, so that you can play on phones, tablets, and even on Steam, while sharing the same save file on all 3 platforms.

Thanks again for all the support and we are super happy to have HPAWS mobile out in the wild!

notes.title: Game Crashing at Splash Screens Fix
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

So we've had a few players comment on the fact that their game is crashing when going through the Developer and Publisher Splash videos. We think we may have found a solution, but we are unsure if this works on everyone's machines.

What we have done is we have enabled a new beta branch called live_test, which has the newest patch on it that should fix the crashing issues. If you are amongst one of those that gets a crash, we would be ever so grateful if you could switch over to the beta branch to see if the game is now working properly!

To switch branches, please follow the instructions below:

1. When in your Steam library, right click on Holy Potatoes! A Weapon Shop?! and click on properties.
2. Click on the "Betas" tab.
3. Click on the drop down menu and select the branch called "live_test"

Do let us know if this fixes your issue, as if this is the case, we will then make this new patch live on the public branch so everyone can access the fix!

Thanks again for your patience and understanding and we hope this has fixed everyone's issue!

notes.title: Linux Release and Chinese Localization for HPWIS
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We are only a couple of hours away from releasing Holy Potatoes! We're in Space?! We are all super excited here at Daylight Studios even though it is nearing midnight :D

I know this announcement is last minute and it comes with a heavy heart that we have to say this, but due to some unforeseen circumstances we have had to push back the release date of the Linux version of Holy Potatoes! We're in Space?! Although we have thoroughly tested on Linux, there are still a few critical bugs that occur here and there and we cannot justify releasing it at the same time as the Mac and Windows versions. Having said that, we are still testing the ever living spud out of it and it should be released sooner rather than later.

As for the Chinese (Simplified) localization, there have been some complications with it and we have determined that the quality of it is just not up to par, so we will also have to push this back and it will not be released with the game in a couple hours. All other languages are accounted for and will be available as soon as the game comes out though!

Thanks again to everyone for all the support and we are sorry we have had to push a couple of things back, but we are still super excited and looking forward to releasing Holy Potatoes! We're in Space?! in a couple hours :D

notes.title: Temporarily Disabling Russian Language

After a lot of feedback we have decided to disable the Russian Language option temporarily due to it being sub-par. We would like to apologize for the quality of the translation and now know that the work was not done well.

Although the Russian language is disabled, if you had selected Russian before this update your game will still be in Russian. If you wish to continue playing in Russian, please do not change the language options as you will NOT be able to revert back to Russian.

For all other players, the Russian language will not be visible in the Language Options in the Main Menu.

Thank you all for the feedback you have given us and we are now doing extensive quality testing to make sure that the Russian language translation is polished up.

notes.title: Call to Arms: Help with Japanese and Russian Language Testing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We firstly want to thank everyone for the support you guys have given us and for being involved with the community!

With that being said, in a separate discussion we announced that the Japanese and Russian versions of Holy Potatoes! were due soon, and they are nearly finalized! We have tested the localized builds to the best of our ability, but we feel there is always more room for improvement. The issue now being that we can't decipher the hieroglyphics of the languages, and therefore can't double check and proofread everything the overseas teams have sent us...

So this announcement serves as a call to arms, and we'd like to ask if anyone is interested in trying out Holy Potatoes! A Weapon Shop?! in either Japanese or Russian (of course, you'd have to be fluent in the language!) before it is released to the public. We just need help in determining whether there are spelling errors, or anything minor that we may have overlooked!

If anyone could be so kind as to help us out, we would be forever grateful! We will have a beta branch build up very soon, and if anyone wants to join the hunt, we could hand out the password for the branch and use this thread as a means to discuss any errors (hopefully there are none!).

Again, a big thank you to everyone!

notes.title: (Journal Patch UPLOADED!) Localisation and Journal Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Journal Patch is now Live![/h1]

We are eager to announce that the Journal Patch has been uploaded! This current patch update will enable you to use the Journal, the details of which are outlined below! Also, some minor fixes were made in the current patch.

[h1]NOTE***[/h1]

When you first open the Journal it will not be able to track previous weapons that have won awards in the Golden Hammer Awards, only future weapons that win awards will begin being tracked by your Journal. Everything else outlined below should be tracked by your Journal when you first open it (such as Smiths you have hired and Legendary Hero requests you have completed).

As for the localisations, the [b]Japanese[/b], [b]Russian[/b], and [b]Spanish[/b] versions should go live sometime in November. We will be updating this post when exact dates are finalized!
__________________________________________________________________

We are happy to announce that we will be localising [i]Holy Potatoes! A Weapon Shop?![/i] for the following languages:
[list]
[*][b]French[/b]
[*][b]German[/b]
[*][b]Italian[/b]
[*][b]Japanese[/b]
[*][b]Russian[/b]
[*][b]Spanish[/b]
[/list]
The [b]Japanese[/b], [b]Russian[/b], and [b]Spanish[/b] versions will be released in the near future, whereas [b]French[/b], [b]German[/b], and [b]Italian[/b] will be available a little later on. We will be posting further updates on exact release dates as soon as the translations are finalized!

[h1]JOURNAL UPDATE[/h1]

Have you ever wondered about the greyed out icon beside the Smith Portraits on the bottom of your screen? Many of you have asked and we remained a little secretive about it... until now! The time has come to finally reveal the [i][b]JOURNAL[/b][/i]!

The Journal will be used to track various aspects of your [i]Holy Potatoes! A Weapon Shop?![/i] play-through. Firstly, you'll be able to track the Legendary Hero Requests you have completed! Each Legendary Hero Request you complete will have its own special page, where you will be able to view the rewards you received, and re-watch their cutscenes!

[url=http://i.imgur.com/cYxezRd.png]Legendary Hero Journal Page Preview[/url]

With the Journal, you will also be able to track the heroes you have sold your weapons to and their information, and the smiths and Legendary Smiths you have hired. Just like the Legendary Heroes, you will be able to re-watch the Legendary Smiths' cutsenes!

Lastly, you will be able to track the best and strongest weapons you have sold! As if that wasn't enough, you will also be able to track which weapons ended up winning awards during the Golden Hammer Awards!

[url=https://i.imgur.com/cVFCYdl.jpg]Weapons Journal Page Preview[/url]

As of now, the Journal will be implemented into the game with an update in the first week or so of November. We will be releasing the exact date in the next few days, so keep your eyes [i]peeled[/i]!

[b][i]Spud Tales[/i][/b] are missions that place you in various scenarios with different end goals, objectives, and difficulty levels. The aim of the game is to complete all the objectives of the specific scenario. When you begin a scenario, you will be taken to a shop separate from the one you own in your normal play-through and will be given a major task to complete. notes.title: (24 July 2015 Patch is Here!) Player Feedback Game Improvements!
notes.notes:
[b](24 July 2015 PATCH)  Uploaded! See below for what's new![/b]

[b]Screen Resolution & Window Mode[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
-We have received loads of requests for this and we are already working on this! More information about this will be listed in a separate thread.

[b]THE PAUSE BUTTON[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
-All hail, the pause button! Yes! It is coming! 
- If can make sure that this is bug free by Friday, this goes in! If not, we will wait for the next patch!
-Pause will be controlled by SPACE BAR. Deactivating Pause by pressing the Space Bar key again takes the player but to his previous speed.
-Note that any action made with the smiths will immediately resume the game to the previous speed.
-This version of the pause button does not provide full control but we would like to release this version first and get more feedback.

[b]Keyboard shortcuts for Speed Control[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
-A highly requested feature was to be able to control speed using shortcuts.
-UPDATE- Based on popular demand, here's the decision with this feature:
- Speed will be controlled by number keys from 1(normal), 2(fast), 3(fastest)
- We have decided not to implement a slower speed for now since we are working on the Pause button. Should there be a great demand for a slower speed even when the pause button is implemented, we will reconsider this.

[b]Sorting of Enchantment Items[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
WHY ARE THE ENCHANTMENT ITEMS IN A MESS?!
Well, they shouldn't be! And we will get them sorted out in this upcoming patch!
Enchantment Items will be sorted by type and in descending power of boost.

[b]Research List Sorting[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
The research list will by default show items that have not been researched with previously researched combinations hidden. Players can click on the check box to show/hide previously researched items.

Various Minor Bug and Balancing Fixes. - DONE & Uploaded

Bug Fix: Someone suggested to show the player's name when you click on Patata in the shop - DONE & Uploaded
Bug Fix: Right-clicking to go back when you have selected a location is much smoother now - DONE & Uploaded
Bug Fix: Legendary Heroes requests have been rebalanced slightly. We'll need your feedback on this - DONE & Uploaded
Bug Fix: Vacation Packages information in the World Map is now much more helpful - DONE & Uploaded

[b]What's Next?[/b]

[b]Multi-smith selection[/b] - Definitely going into next patch!
We are currently investigating if we can enable multiple smith selection when sending smiths to explore, train, go on a vacation. This should add more convenience for all players.

More stuff to be added soon!

==================================================================
[b](17 July 2015 PATCH) Uploaded! See below for what's new![/b]

[b]Golden Hammer Weapon Awards[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
-Competitor weapons will be strengthened to increase difficulty.
-Bring your best Weapons! but you don't, then bring $tarch so you can bribe your way to victory! (Just don't get caught in the process!)

[b]Coffee Breaks[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
-The damn smiths are taking too many coffee breaks! Work 'em harder!
- Smiths will now take less coffee breaks but each mug of coffee will now have a greater morale boost!

[b]Premature Endgame[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
-After completing the final objective, the player can choose to play on after the final cutscene. We know many players have been asking for this and we are working on it! If you are already in the 4th world, please keep a copy of that save file so that you can enjoy this improvement after this patch is done.

[b]Adding Area name to Hero Tooltips[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
-We will be adding Area name to the hero's tooltip when moused over in the forging menu. This will give players greater clarity on which areas to sell your weapons to.

[b]Choice of Fate[/b] - DONE & Uploaded
-Chance of occurance will be reduced considerably
-Answers to Choice of Fate will no longer be random and YES! There will be a right and a wrong answer.
-Rewards and Penalties of getting the right/wrong answer will have a greater effect! So choose wisely!

Bug Fix: Reseach "!" sometimes does not go away after a research is completed will be uploaded within 24 hours. - DONE & Uploaded

Bug Fix: Game running at 60fps now!  - DONE & Uploaded

Bug Fix: 7 missing research weapons  - DONE & Uploaded

Thanks and keep those comments coming!

Always deep fried over baked.
The Holy Potatoes! Dev Team
